object.name: evi_ladder_diode
object.digest: TPT nonlinear Diode Ladder filter emulation
object.description: A 24dB Diode Ladder filter emulation, similar to the Roland-TB303 filter and not like a Transistor Ladder. Different to any of the other evieve Ladders. Unlike the (Moog) Transistor Ladder, the Diode Ladder resonance peaks, rather than scales. So be careful with high resonance! The object provides two FM modulation inlets for the filter cutoff frequency.

inlets.name: cutoff
inlets.digest: Cutoff frequency in Pitch (default) or Hz depending on the @cutoffmode attribute.

inlets.name: cutoff
inlets.digest: Logarithmic FM input. Accepts an FM signal which is summed internally with cutoff in pitch prior to Linear FM inlet. This is only active if @cutoffmode attribute == 1, otherwise it is ignored.

inlets.name: cutoff
inlets.digest: Linear FM input. Accepts an FM signal which is summed internally with cutoff in Hz post Logarithmic FM input. This inlet is always active regardless of the @cutoffmode attribute.

inlets.name: resonance
inlets.digest: Self oscillates at resonance==1 but can take higher resonance with a little loss in tuning.

attributes.name: cutoffmode
attributes.description: Switch cutoff frequency (inlet 2) between Pitch (default on) or Hz (off).

attributes.name: cutoffsmooth
attributes.description: Optionally smooth the cutoff (inlet 2). If audio rate modulating inlet 2 (or potentially with inlets 3 or 4) this should be turned off.

attributes.name: nonlin
attributes.description: 0=tanh-like, 1=polynomial-saturator, 2=cubic (default), 3=cubic-alternative, 4=atan-like. Unlike unit delay filters, TPT filters allow us to switch out the nonlinearity in the feedback loop without having to retune the filter. Each options gives the filter slightly different characteristics.

attributes.name: oversample
attributes.description: 2x oversampling if on (default), 1x if off (careful). Oversampling almost doubles the CPU usage.

attributes.name: ressmooth
attributes.description: Optionally smooth the resonance (inlet 5). If audio rate modulating inlet 5 this should be turned off.
